scripts.text:
INSERT INTO [App].[ImportRun]
           ([PackageType]
           ,[PackageGuid]
           ,[CreatedDate]
           ,[Status]
           ,[ProcessingDir])
VALUES
           ('USS_PreExecute'
           ,NEWID()
           ,GetDate()
           ,'Execute'
           ,CONVERT(varchar(255),@Folder))

SET @ImportRunId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

INSERT INTO [App].[ImportFile]
           ([ImportRunId]
           ,[FileName]
           ,[Status]
           ,[FileDate]
           ,[FileNameScheme]
           ,[Client]
           ,[Location]
           ,[Scheme])
     VALUES
           (@ImportRunId
           ,@FileName
           ,'Execute'
           ,GetDate()
           ,NULL
           ,NULL
           ,NULL
           ,NULL)


SET @ImportFileID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

SET @hasErrored = 1

UPDATE [App].[ImportRun]
SET Status = 'Invalid file name' + @file
WHERE Id = @importRunId


UPDATE [App].[ImportFile]
SET Status =  'Invalid file name' + @file
WHERE Id = @importFileId

INSERT INTO [App].[ImportError]
           ([ImportRunId]
           ,[ImportFileId]
           ,[Message])
     VALUES (@importRunId, @importFileId, 'Invalid file name format')

INSERT INTO [App].[Log]
           ([Process]
           ,[ExternalID]
           ,[LogType]
           ,[LogMessage]
           ,[LogTime]
           ,[LogNumber]
           ,[Source]
           ,[DetailedMessage]
           ,[LogLevel]
           ,[LogCode])
     VALUES
           ('ChannelAsset_Execute'
           ,@importRunId
           ,'Error'
           ,'Filename validation has failed'
           ,GetDate()
           ,0
           ,'ChannelAsset_Execute'
           ,'Failed to extract ' + @file + ''
           ,NULL
           ,NULL)

DECLARE @count INT

SET @hasErrored = 0

Select @count = Count(id) from App.ImportError WHERE ImportRunId = @importRunId

IF @count > 0
BEGIN
 SET @hasErrored = 1
END

SET @hasErrored = 1

UPDATE [App].[ImportRun]
SET Status = 'Extract failed'
WHERE Id = @importRunId


UPDATE [App].[ImportFile]
SET Status =  'Extract failed'
WHERE Id = @importFileId

INSERT INTO [App].[Log]
           ([Process]
           ,[ExternalID]
           ,[LogType]
           ,[LogMessage]
           ,[LogTime]
           ,[LogNumber]
           ,[Source]
           ,[DetailedMessage]
           ,[LogLevel]
           ,[LogCode])
     VALUES
           ('NorthernTrust_Execute'
           ,@importRunId
           ,'Error'
           ,'Extract step has failed'
           ,GetDate()
           ,0
           ,'NorthernTrust_Execute'
           ,'Failed to extract ' + @file + '. Please have a look at the App.ImportError for detailes.'
           ,NULL
           ,NULL)
